entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand GPS tracker I bought.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The pulse reader is garbage, completely inaccurate. I don't have time for this, I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear the pulse reader isn't meeting your expectations. We do have a technical support team that can help troubleshoot that. It might just be a simple calibration issue.
No. I am not troubleshooting. I don't have time to sit on the phone trying to fix a brand new product. I just want money back for something that doesn't work. Can you process a refund or not?
I understand your frustration. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, about 20 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return. You're well within that timeframe, so yes, I can absolutely process this for you.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Simply pack the device in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
